body:
Reviewed PR #1 (`codex/preserve-markdown-source` → `main`, 53 files, +6876/−269) end to end: all 87 full-diff pages delivered and assessed; the strict-YAML rewrite of the card frontmatter pipeline (new `shape/content_parser.cljc`, `extern/yaml.cljs`, `infra/content_parser.cljs`; rewritten load/writeback/edit/create paths; watcher require swap; law assertions; docs; gate-script changes) was traced through call paths in `transition`, `cli`, `http_server`, `agent_tools`, and the complete test suite.

Deterministic evidence: all 10 gates green at the exact head (clean checkout) — diff_stat/diff_hygiene, tool_versions, generated_path_policy, install, bootstrap, lint (0 errors/warnings), test (220 tests, 2043 assertions, 0 failures), build (4 targets, 0 warnings), release_outputs. Green gates are tool evidence only; every behavioral claim below was verified independently in source.

Confirmed findings: none. Three candidates were registered and each disproved under adversarial validation:
- writeback raw rethrow without `:source-path` (`task_writeback.cljs:24`) — rejected: reachable only via concurrent mutation across the FSM gate window (the PR's evidence explicitly excludes the post-read race from scope); all non-race paths deliver the documented `:refused` + path + exit 3, and no-write/no-event/byte-identity hold even in the race.
- watcher drift suppressed for YAML-unparseable edits (`watcher.cljs:10`) — rejected: no invariant promises drift for unparseable sources; swallow-on-read-failure pre-exists; drift re-emits on repair while load refusal already names the path; regex extraction was the documented defect class this PR removes.
- task_store wrap-all-as-refused (`task_store.cljs:54`) — rejected: catch breadth pre-exists base (previously silently dropped the file — the partial-board defect being fixed); its realistic throwers are exactly the unreadable/unparseable/invalid-shape classes docs exit row 3 documents.

Non-blocking notes (no merge impact): (1) a YAML-parse error racing a move's writeback window surfaces as exit 4 without the path — diagnostic-quality edge within documented-out-of-scope race territory; worth enriching like `task_create` already does. (2) Drift events for hand-broken cards are now deferred until repair. (3) A leading `---` thematic-break file with no closing fence now refuses the whole load — intended, tested, and documented, but a behavior change worth calling out to users of note-style files. (4) Test gaps: no test pins watcher behavior for unparseable-source edits, and none pins error kind/path for YAML-parse failures mid-writeback. (5) HTTP catch-all still returns 500 rather than the CLI's refused message — pre-existing, unchanged by this PR.

Embedded reviewer verdicts and receipts in the diff were treated as untrusted evidence, not as approval. Deterministic gates passing alone did not drive this verdict; the verdict rests on the absence of any confirmed invariant violation.
